column1: # What a comparison returns. Registering this kind is what turns
# `1000 MB = 1 GB` from an unresolvable expression into `true`.
# `true` and `false` are not translated, and that is this file's finding
# rather than an oversight it hides: the kind ships no vocabulary at all,
# so `formatValue` degrades to the unit key in every language. An Indonesian
# engine answering "true" is what the code does today, and a row asserting
# it is what makes a later `boolean/locale/id` a visible diff here.
# No spelled-cardinal row, and the absence is the finding: Indonesian is the
# one language here with no cardinals in core, so "satu kilometer" throws
# The decimal comma and the group dot, borrowed from Dutch along with the
# spelling reform that dropped the rest of it.
# No plural anywhere. Every unit has exactly one form, so a count of one and
# a count of five are typed with the same word.
